segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: Hello, and welcome to the Sheep, Dog 'n' Wolf Show, or as I like to call it, Who Wants to Be a Sheep Stealer?

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: Listen, bub. All you got to do is relax and play the game. I got to use this gig to catapult me to superstardom!

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: Now, the aim of our game is simple: to steal sheep.

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: You will go through a series of levels. At each of those levels, you will have to steal a sheep from Sam Sheepdog and put it in the goal.

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: If you succeed, you may proceed to the next challenge, and so on, until you finally steal the entire flock!

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: But, and this is a big "but", the sheep must be intact at the end of each level. You'll be disqualified if any of the sheep are missing so much as a thread of wool.

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: Have I made myself perfectly clear? Mmm?
